n01.text: One ant colony had a big question. Could ants live on Mars?

n02.text: Earth and Mars line up only once every two years.

n03.text: Kepler and Comet launched right on time.

n04.text: Seven months later, they reached Mars.

n05.text: The next ship would not come for two more years.

n06.text: Two ants. One empty planet. A home to build before the rest arrive.
